description: "The Glories of Mary" by Saint Alfonso Maria de' Liguori is a Catholic devotional work written during the 18th century. This classic Mariology text defends devotion to the Blessed Virgin Mary through citations from Church Fathers and Doctors of the Church, combined with the author's personal views.
